faqDesc: Find answers to common questions about our products, orders, shipping, and returns.
faqPaymentMethodsQ: What payment methods do you accept?
faqPaymentMethodsA: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and bank transfers for larger orders. All payments are processed securely through our PCI-compliant payment gateway.
faqProcessingTimeQ: How long does order processing take?
faqProcessingTimeA: Most orders are processed within 1-2 business days. During peak seasons, processing may take up to 3 business days. You'll receive an email confirmation with tracking information once your order ships.
faqModifyCancelQ: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
faqModifyCancelA: Orders can be modified or cancelled within 2 hours of placement if they haven't been processed yet. Please contact our customer service team immediately with your order number. Once an order has been processed for shipping, we cannot cancel or modify it.
faqShippingOptionsQ: What are your shipping options and costs?
faqStandardShippingCost: FREE on orders over $50, $9.99 for orders under $50
faqInternationalShippingCost: Rates calculated at checkout based on destination and weight
faqInternationalA: Yes, we ship to most countries worldwide. International shipping rates are calculated at checkout based on the destination country, package weight, and dimensions. Delivery times vary by location and can take 7-21 business days. Additional customs fees may apply.
faqTrackOrderQ: How can I track my order?
faqTrackOrderA: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with tracking information. You can also track your order by:
faqTrackOrderA1: Logging into your account and viewing your order history
faqTrackOrderA2: Using the "Track Your Order" link in our footer
faqTrackOrderA3: Contacting our customer service with your order number
faqReturnPolicyA: We offer a 30-day return policy for most items. Items must be unused, in their original packaging, and include all tags. Some items like personalized products, intimate apparel, and clearance items are not eligible for returns. See our full returns page for complete details.
faqInitiateReturnQ: How do I initiate a return or exchange?
faqInitiateReturnA: To initiate a return or exchange:
faqInitiateReturnA1: Contact our customer service team within 30 days of delivery
faqInitiateReturnA2: Provide your order number and reason for return
faqInitiateReturnA3: Receive a return authorization and prepaid shipping label
faqInitiateReturnA4: Pack the item securely and include the return authorization
faqInitiateReturnA5: Ship the package using the provided label
faqWarrantyQ: Do your products come with a warranty?
faqWarrantyA: Yes, all our products come with a manufacturer's warranty. Warranty periods vary by product category:
faqWarrantyNote: Warranties cover manufacturing defects but do not cover normal wear and tear, misuse, or accidental damage.
faqCreateAccountQ: How do I create an account?
faqCreateAccountA: Creating an account is easy and free. Click the "Sign Up" link in the top navigation, or create an account during checkout. You'll need to provide your email address and create a password. Accounts allow you to track orders, save shipping addresses, and access exclusive offers.
faqResetPasswordQ: How do I reset my password?
faqResetPasswordA: To reset your password, click "Forgot Password" on the sign-in page. Enter your email address, and we'll send you a secure link to create a new password. The link expires in 24 hours for security reasons.
faqContactSupportQ: How do I contact customer support?

faqContactLiveChatValue: Available on our website during business hours
